collar_tag_req: All dogs must be licensed with the Township. The dog tag must be affixed to the dog and is valid for the lifetime of the registered dog.
dog_limit: Not explicitly stated in available municipal summaries; operating a kennel for breeding or boarding requires a separate Kennel Licence under By-law No. 2003-30.
notes: URL: https://seguin.ca/find-law. The full consolidated text of By-law 2002-056 is not available online, but municipal summaries outline standard licensing rules. Seguin's Noise By-law 2023-030 restricts barking but does not provide an explicit exemption for agricultural operations or farm dogs.

lgd_definition: “Livestock guardian dog” means a dog that works and lives with domestic farm animals, including but not limited to livestock for the purposes of protection from predation;
collar_tag_req: The Owner shall keep the tag securely fixed on the Dog at all times until the tag is renewed or replaced, except while the Dog is being lawfully used for hunting or working. It is encouraged that Owners have Hunting Dogs and Working Dogs micro-chipped or appropriate collar identification of the Owner.
dog_limit: No person shall harbour or permit to be harboured at any one time, more than three (3) dogs on a property or per dwelling unit inclusive of a hunting dog, working dog, service dog or guide dog.
notes: URL: https://www.southgate.ca/media/dpjdxwb5/by-law-2024-078-canine-control-by-law-for-website.pdf. Farm-friendly by-law that explicitly defines 'Livestock guardian dog' (and includes them under the 'Working Dog' definition). It specifically exempts working dogs from having to wear a physical tag while working to prevent snagging or injury. Note that the 3-dog limit explicitly includes working dogs unless a kennel license is obtained. The Township's Noise By-law (2021-132) contains a broad exemption for Agricultural Operations.

collar_tag_req: Effective January 1, 2026, the Municipality ended its dog licensing and registration program. Residents are no longer required to purchase or renew dog tags.
dog_limit: There is a strict limit of two (2) dogs per household. The total number of cats and dogs in a household cannot exceed four (4). A kennel license may be issued to the owner of confined dogs kept exclusively for hunting, working or dog-sled purposes (which allows keeping more than two dogs).
notes: URL: https://www.southhuron.ca/media/bgxbb4v1/animal-control-by-law-21-2018-office-consolidation.pdf. The municipality abolished its dog licensing and tagging program entirely effective 2026. A strict 2-dog limit per household remains in effect, but "working" dogs are explicitly listed as a permitted reason to apply for a kennel licence.

collar_tag_req: The Township discontinued municipal dog tags in 2022. Pet owners must provide alternative identification, such as a personalized ID tag or microchip, kept securely fixed on the dog at all times when off the owner's dwelling.
dog_limit: No person shall keep more than three (3) dogs in a dwelling unit within the Township on all zoned properties. Anyone keeping more than 3 dogs requires a kennel license.
notes: URL: https://www.swox.org/media/px3kch22/76-2017-animal-care-and-control-by-law-consolidated-2023.pdf. The dog limit explicitly applies to 'all zoned properties', which includes agricultural zones, with no exemptions mentioned for working farm dogs. However, the Township's Noise By-Law No. 49-2021 is explicitly farm-friendly; it restricts persistent barking from "any domestic pet or any other animal kept or used for any purpose other than agriculture," thereby entirely exempting agricultural working dogs from the barking restrictions.

collar_tag_req: Every dog in Springwater must be licensed and wear the licensing tag on their collar at all times.
dog_limit: There is a limit of four (4) dogs per single detached home or two (2) dogs per multi-residential household. A kennel license is required for more than 3 dogs (By-law 2008-118).
notes: URL: https://www.springwater.ca/living-here/animal-services/. Standard animal control bylaw with no distinct exemptions or provisions for working farm dogs or LGDs found.

collar_tag_req: All dogs and cats living in Stratford must be registered with the City and wear a valid tag.
dog_limit: No person shall keep or harbour or permit to be kept or harboured more than three (3) unaltered dogs or cats on property in the city of Stratford.
notes: URL: https://www.stratford.ca/en/inside-city-hall/resources/CORPORATE-SERVICES/CLERKS/Animal-Control---195-2002---Accessible.pdf. A highly urban-focused animal control by-law enforced by the Stratford-Perth Humane Society. Uniquely restricts households to a maximum of three (3) unaltered dogs/cats, meaning there is no strict cap on the number of spayed/neutered pets. The by-law explicitly lists animals used for agricultural purposes as prohibited in the city limits.

collar_tag_req: Dog and cat owners are required to register their pet every year. The Town of St. Marys issues lifetime pet tags.
dog_limit: Not explicitly stated online, but keeping a large number of dogs requires a $300/year Kennel Licence.
notes: URL: https://www.townofstmarys.com/home-property-roads/animal-services/pet-licences/. Standard animal control bylaw. Service animals supporting persons with visual or hearing disabilities are exempt from annual fees, but there are no mentions of fee exemptions or definitions for farm dogs or LGDs.

collar_tag_req: If you own a dog in the Municipality of Strathroy-Caradoc, your dog must be licensed and the tag must be attached to the dog at all times when he or she is not on your property.
dog_limit: Standard limit applies; kennels are defined as establishments where three or more dogs are housed, boarded or bred.
notes: URL: https://www.strathroy-caradoc.ca/media/30bfz0a3/bylaw6009-animalcareandcontrol.pdf. The municipality abolished dog licence fees in 2009. The Municipality issues permanent dog tags for the lifetime of the dog at no charge for everyone.

lgd_definition: “Livestock Guardian Dog” means a Dog that works and/or lives with Livestock to protect them while repelling predators and is kept exclusively for that purpose.
herding_definition: “Herding Dog” means a Dog that has been trained and is actively being used in an agricultural operation for the purposes of controlling Livestock.
collar_tag_req: All dogs must be licensed yearly, including those owned by Kennel Owners/Operators. The dog tag must be affixed to the dog.
dog_limit: No person shall keep more than three (3) dogs in any one dwelling unit or on any premises, unless they possess a Kennel Licence.
notes: URL: https://www.tecumseh.ca/media/pvnl1z1b/by-law-2025-087-animal-control-signed-updated.pdf. A newly enacted bylaw (2025) that is highly farm-friendly. It explicitly includes exact and accurate definitions for both 'Livestock Guardian Dog' and 'Herding Dog', distinguishing them from standard pets, and exempts them from being designated as a 'Dangerous Dog' while performing their protective duties. Properties with more than 3 dogs still need to obtain a Kennel Licence.

collar_tag_req: Licenses are required for all dogs living in Thorold. They must be renewed every year and the tags should be worn.
dog_limit: Keeping four (4) or more dogs requires a Kennel classification, effectively limiting households to 3 dogs.
notes: URL: https://www.thorold.ca/en/business-services/resources/BUILDING-/BY_LAWS/Consolidated-79-2017.Animal-Care-and-Control.pdf. Standard animal control bylaw with a strict restriction against persistent barking exceeding 20 minutes. No specific definitions, provisions, or exemptions were found for farm working dogs or LGDs.
